The Three Seals

Awaken the Moon, Sun, and Star runes in three distant chambers. Their power unseals the golden key. Recover it, then reach the wormhole before the ten-minute countdown ends.

Two power slots
Only two gates or bridges can be ON. The purple Architect spirit marks your selection; Q/E moves it and Space casts. Close passages behind you.
Q / E · Space
Select · toggle a maze element
Gate ON

R / Reveal
Reveal the whole maze for 3 seconds; recharge takes 12 seconds
P / Escape
Pause / resume

Gates take time to rise and bridges must fully extend before crossing. Occupied passages cannot close. The key requires all three runes; the east lock requires the key. Laptop challenge mode — the original R4 firmware controls a different, smaller map.
